name: Path of the Dawn
blurb: Light given shape. Mages spend Mana and strike from range.

skills.name: Mote of Dawn
skills.description: Hold to aim, release to loose a bolt of light in a straight line. It strikes the first enemy in its path.
skills.lore: The first light anyone learns to hold.

skills.name: Lance of Morning
skills.description: A heavier lance of light that pierces every enemy in a long straight line.

skills.name: Censer Spark
skills.description: A spark that leaps between up to 3 nearby enemies.

skills.name: Aegis of Vespers
skills.description: A small ward that absorbs damage for a few seconds.

skills.name: Votive Ward
skills.description: A lighter ward; whatever it doesn't absorb returns as healing when it fades.

skills.name: Choir's Fan
skills.description: A fan of light right in front of you.

skills.name: Sunwell
skills.description: Opens a pool of light at a point that pulses damage for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Seraph Step
skills.description: Blink a short distance toward the cursor.
skills.lore: Wings you only feel, never see.

skills.name: Gilded Glide
skills.description: Glide forward, leaving a trail of light that slows enemies.

skills.name: Pillar of Matins
skills.description: After a short delay a column of light strikes the target area.

skills.name: Halo Bind
skills.description: A ring of light that roots the first enemy hit.

skills.name: Beacon of Saints
skills.description: For 8 seconds your magic damage is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Reliquary Orbs
skills.description: Three orbs circle you, striking enemies they touch.

skills.name: Judgement Ray
skills.description: Charge, then release a long beam that pierces every enemy in a line.
skills.lore: Light that has made up its mind.

skills.name: Sanctum
skills.description: Consecrate the ground around you: you take 30% less damage while inside.

skills.name: Dawnbreak
skills.description: Call the sunrise down on an area. Enormous damage after a brief delay.

skills.name: Ascension
skills.description: Become radiant for 10 seconds: +35% magic damage and faster cooldowns.

secrets.name: Sunfall Verdict
secrets.description: Call the full weight of the dawn down on a wide area. Devastating, and slow to return.
secrets.lore: Only those who have looked the dark in the eye are taught this.
